themeTitle: Sovereignty and Security of the Modern Economy
themeDescription: From mandating domestic atomic-clock time standards and fortifying cooperative banking security, to mapping independent military drone development and absorbing global energy transit shocks, India is building resilient domestic walls to protect its fast-growing economy from external volatility.
